notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Simulated R0 device, model-authored and unreviewed: no hardware run, no human review, and the hardware backend does not exist. The upstream is Python 2 code over Panda3D and the SUNCG data loader (home_env_basic.py:5-10) and was never imported or run; fake.py is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in for HomeEnv. It does not model Bullet contacts, friction, gravity, collision detection or the renderer (collision is always 0); it returns a 4 x 4 x 3 image as a placeholder for the upstream 500 x 500 x 3 image (home_env_basic.py:57); it does not add the 1000-step TimeLimit of gym.make('Home-v0') (gym/__init__.py:6), so done is always False; and it maps any non-negative seed to the only house the clone ships, whereas upstream asserts seed < len(list_of_houses) (home_env_basic.py:85), so the upstream path would refuse a seed above 0. The sim backend (gym.make('Home-v0') through GymnasiumDriver) was not run and would also need the upstream package imported to register Home-v0. Expected warnings, all explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only records the seed for the next reset, no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset and step, which HomeEnv inherits from the external gym.Env base that G7 cannot follow; and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.values[*] and the two seed inputs. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
